newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Glengarry has 115,000 oz at Kookaburra.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Glengarry has 115,000 oz at Kookaburra.

text.p: Glengarry Resources NL said on Tuesday said it has recorded a preliminary resource of 115,000 ounces of gold at the Kookaburra prospect in Western Australia.
Kookaburra is 50-50 owned by Glengarry and Tanami Gold NL under the Larranganni joint venture agreement.

Glengarry said in a statement that a preliminary resource estimate of 1.7 million tonnes of ore, grading 2.1 grams of gold a tonne, representing 115,000 ounces of gold, has been calculated at a cut-off grade of 0.5 percent.
